From the commit after d293fb6b, tools/locks.sh logs every hold to $RUN_DIR/locks/holds.jsonl (request with the command, parent pid, free disk and the wait cap; acquired with the wait and the holder's own pid and process group, so a job is stopped by that pid; released with the exit code; timeout), refuses a lock when free disk is below a floor (LOCK_DISK_FLOOR_GB, 20), and tools/hygiene_check.py checks the log (H1 one holder at a time per lock, H2 every hold released or its holder alive, H3 hold time <= 3 h, H4 disk floor, H5 a stoppable pid, H6 wait caps and outcomes, H7 well-formed lines; self-test with seeded violations); verify.sh runs the self-test in every mode and the check over its own window at the end. Open until a registered gate has run the check. Not covered: a job that never goes through locks.sh. Recorded lapses before the log: uncoordinated connections 23:02:53-23:03:40 UTC (IVG460SNAP), a heavy-lock deadlock from wrapping a self-locking proof runner (stopped by PID), licence exhaustion by the scratch-236 suites (HEALTH-ALERT-0119), and overwritten proof logs (superseded-logs.json).

PROOF-DEBT.md lists every unproved obligation (D-1..D-14) with the evidence that stands instead and why the proof is missing; paid rows name their decisive runs; nothing is reported as proved without a decisive Verus run with an empty trust inventory. Open debt: D-2..D-8, D-11.

Interpretation corrected (operator, 2026-11-14 22:45 UTC; verification-playbook.txt:479-489): the hard 20-minute bound is on the merge gate, a single build on one machine whose blocking checks are real-database tests of the touched slices plus a fixed canary set, the spec and trust checks and Verus on the changed crates only (a time or resource limit is debt, not a failure); full controls and every crate belong to the periodic full verification. verify.sh --merge re-executes itself under timeout 1200 and passed on 20e3b336 in 215 s (base 25ba22dd; changed crate proofs-env verified; 12 unchanged crates reused after their sources hashes and their base gate exits were checked; canaries: the contract's named cases, trace conformance, F-1201; touched slices 03, 10, 11, 17; module 13 via the ledger canaries). Two earlier failing merge runs are kept; they show the gate blocks. 'Touched slices' in this observation-only audit are the modules whose verification artifacts changed since the base; the product source is pinned. The periodic full verification is verify.sh --live --clean (verify-clean-25ba22dd, 5,119 s). Slice selection (review A-02, tightened after the addendum): a change to a shared harness (traces/, iris-contract/, contract-2/, live probes, trace-replay's library, iris_conn/locks) replays every runnable module; otherwise the modules whose verification files or matrix cells changed since the base; modules whose replay is blocked (15: no FHIR server) are listed, not run. A Verus time or resource limit is written to merge-debt.jsonl and reported as inconclusive, never as a pass (A-01). proofs-env (D-7) postdates the base 25ba22dd, so it has not yet been through a periodic full verification; its lane baseline, controls and recheck stand.
